scope: Commit tested kernel9 and the integrated UI/RGB/history/CCR and kernel7/8 lineage required to reproduce it; exclude unfinished unrelated research.
excluded_groups: Future B53/glibc/systemd userspace plans and probes

secret_review.authorization_field_classification: Natural-language user authorization records, not Authorization header values or tokens.
secret_review.method: Full current Git-visible UTF-8 file scan for private keys, known token formats, literal auth headers/credential URLs/curl users, literal credential assignments, credential-named JSON strings and bulk NVRAM key-value dumps. Only paths/counts are emitted; ignored backups, packages and secrets are excluded. Changed/new release files were read separately.
secret_review.limitations: Pattern/structure inspection is not a proof that no arbitrary unlabelled secret exists; only reviewed repository-visible text is covered.

reproduction_notes: Includes explicit kernel7/8/9 configs, original ordered patch stack, build/cache tooling, QEMU/direct ABI probes, accepted integrated web/RGB/collector source and versioned integration/packaging/flash preparation gates.
Vendor firmware, SDK/toolchains, signing key and generated rootfs/Image/packages remain external or ignored; no private key or binary artifact is proposed for staging.
Build dependencies retained in this list must be committed together; individual stage scripts depend on reviewed inputs from prior integrated releases.

kernel9_script_review.method: Read-only source review, including comparison against accepted kernel8 packaging scripts and the bounded watcher/safe hardware probe preparation. No deployment or test script executed by this auditor.
checks: Pinned Image9 and integrated rootfs8 hashes
Only manifest/start identity changes allowed; v8 module inventory unchanged
Exact combined QEMU and package/signature/hash gates
Stock slot2 required before inactive slot1 writes; slot2 hashes preserved
Services hook accepts only exact reviewed kernel6/kernel8/kernel9 startup hashes
Watcher uses trusted SSH host keys, hidden password entry, bounded observation and a new boot/root/build identity check; no router writes.
Hardware preparation removes the clock-changing regression mode, uses guarded kernel9 raw probes and isolated temporary glibc runtimes.

git_and_firmware_commit_distinction.git_commit: Records source, patches, configuration and evidence in this repository; parent will act only after accepted kernel9 boot.
git_and_firmware_commit_distinction.firmware_boot_commit: Separate permanent boot-slot metadata action; not part of this path list and must not be inferred from a Git commit.

resolved_reference_findings.resolution: Optional background link removed without importing deferred userspace research; historical kernel8 evidence retained.

physical_acceptance_at_review.scope: Read the root agent acceptance records; this auditor did not access the live router.

validation.git_diff_check: Initial tracked-working-tree check passed; it did not cover then-untracked artifacts. The full staged check returns 2 with the classified exceptions below; it is not a clean full-stage pass.

staged_whitespace_review.artifact_classification: All 659 diagnostics in the four .patch files point to unified-diff context lines. The outer added-file diff treats the mandatory context prefix as source indentation or trailing whitespace, including context blank lines. The remaining two diagnostics are trailing spaces in preserved upstream evidence.
staged_whitespace_review.inner_added_line_method: Strip the added-line marker only inside unified-diff hunks, then inspect actual new source for trailing whitespace and spaces followed by tabs in leading indentation.

inner_added_indentation_exceptions.finding: Two __get_user continuation lines contain spaces before a tab in indentation. These are real style exceptions, distinct from the outer-patch context diagnostics; they do not change C tokens or runtime behavior.
inner_added_indentation_exceptions.disposition: Retained unchanged because the tested and deployed patch/Image identity is pinned; no claim that all inner added lines are whitespace-clean.

staging_performed_by: root agent after the initial unstaged audit; this auditor made no Git index changes
